race.comment: In a very even sprint, SHE'S ELUSIVE (14) could go well from a low draw. She had sharp form when last in work. Not much has gone right this time in but the blinkers are on now. A quick turnaround in form would not be of surprise. ROYAL TURF (10) has been running similar races. He tends to balance up out the back and find the line. Could well prefer it if the track was softer. ELENA MONTERO (5) will not enjoy the wide draw unless they try to offset it quickly. She was better though at Kilmore and has blinkers added. CILENTO (12) has done little wrong this whole preparation. Won't be in the early action but will get home. TRUE SPIRIT (7) showed much more ability when ridden on the speed at the most recent run.
